page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m4.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data positions this instance in the average tier for most compute and memory tasks. The single-core stress-ng performance score of 1866.99 and multi-core score of 30903.16 reflect steady, predictable processing capabilities. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only large block rate of 152.43 GB/sec and a write rate of 69.06 GB/sec. Notably, the instance demonstrates strong performance in lightweight LLM text generation using a small 135M model, reaching 297.4 tokens per second, while medium 7B model text generation operates at an average rate of 18.36 tokens per second.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.u1-c1m4.8xlarge is the complete absence of local NVMe storage, meaning all disk I/O must go over the network, which can limit performance for highly disk-intensive databases. However, its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer solid resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that do not require local scratch space. It is well-suited for general-purpose applications, static web serving, Redis caching, and medium-scale enterprise workloads.
